capabilities.scope: Vendor boot0, U-Boot and the board-specific DT path boot from microSD.
This board has no Ethernet port. A related A733 board does not establish an Ethernet path here.
AIC8800D80 needs vendor firmware. Nonzero initial IGTK IPN is unsupported in the cited snapshot.
Bounded native Vulkan Compute, offscreen graphics and four KWin/Zink frames have physical acceptance. Physical HDMI, complete Plasma and conformance remain unaccepted.

One fixed INT8 convolution matches all 512 numerical output bytes and checks buffer tails, immutable inputs and MMU tables. Exact HWDB identity is required. Arbitrary models, a general runtime, recovery and sustained workloads remain unaccepted.
